issues.title: Adding extra intercom webhook topics causes infinite loops
issues.body:
Not sure which topics cause the issue, (I selected them all). 

Since we are not checking the topic, other webhooks are triggering the bot to respond to itself causing endless conversations.

The workaround is to only add the two required topics. The solution is to whitelist the topics in the integration code.

linked_prs.title: fix(integrations/intercom): Fix infinite loop when extra webhook topics are enabled
linked_prs.body:
This fixes infinite message loop when bot replies in Intercom and extra webhook topics are enabled. Webhook topic are now filtered so we now just listen to the ones we need.

This also adds resilience to message loops in the case we want to subscribe to additional topics in the future. Some notifications contain conversation parts, so it is possible to encounter the same messages twice. Fixes were made to ensure users are not duplicated (including the bot user) and messages are not duplicated.

Fixes #12707

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue describes an agent workflow anomaly, specifically infinite loops caused by improper webhook topic handling. It aligns with the "Workflow issues" category in the agent issue taxonomy.
